comment: ANCHOR: HERMES_NEWS_BRIDGE_ALL_DUPLICATE_20261109 — LQ-20261107-1330: hermes-news-bridge receipt said
empty_reason=no_new_input on run d:hermes-news-bridge:live:20261108T1840 while attempted_count=2 and
skipped_reasons={duplicate: 2, insert_error: 0} — a run that read two candidates claimed it had no input.
The lane now says all_duplicate for a zero whose every attempted row was a clean duplicate skip, and the
token is registered in all three places a receipt is graded (config/run_quality_idle_reasons.json, the
lane's contract empty_allowed_reasons, and check_n8n_workflow_framework.EMPTY_ALLOWED_REASONS) so the
truthful reason stays an allowed empty instead of becoming a RUN_FAILED. Hermetic: synthetic counts, no DB.
